scene: The telephone box folding door springs open onto a bustling transport platform.
picture: A flat side view along a stone platform. On the left, a striped drone gondola hovers by mooring ropes. The grandmother in her pink tracksuit stands outside the open booth near the centre beside her white dog, while a blue hover metro idles behind her. Far right, a yellow winged scooter rests on kickstands.
shown: a striped drone gondola floating on the far left by the railing
a sleek hover metro train resting on the track at the centre
a winged yellow flying scooter parked on a stand at the far right
